title: A Uniform Divisor-Comparison Method for Meromorphic Identities
summary: We present a uniform method for proving meromorphic function identities by comparing complete zero and pole multisets. A fixed annular Weierstrass normalization represents every nonzero meromorphic function uniquely as \[ q_t=e^{h_t}\frac{p_{Z_t}}{p_{P_t}},\qquad t=([h_t],Z_t,P_t),\qquad [h_t]\in\mathcal O(\mathbb C)/(2πi\mathbb Z). \] Thirteen principal comparisons, together with their specializations and consequences, use the same four steps: represent the two sides, compare their divisors, apply a divisor-comparison theorem (DCT), and normalize $h_s-h_t$.
